scenario_name: Guest had a bad dining experience
expected_behavior: Apologizes specifically for the wait time, acknowledges the price-point expectation. Offers a concrete alternative for tonight with a strong recommendation. Suggests mentioning the issue to the Momentum Desk for potential follow-up. Turns the complaint into a chance to demonstrate that the property cares
expected_behavioral_quality: Takes full ownership of the negative experience. Does not make excuses or deflect. Offers a specific alternative for immediate recovery and a path to formal follow-up. The guest should leave the conversation feeling heard and confident that their next experience will be different.

turns.user_message: We waited 45 minutes for our food at Tuscany last night. Totally unacceptable
turns.agent_response:
I am very sorry to hear about the delay you experienced at Todd English's Tuscany last night. A 45-minute wait for your food is unacceptable and certainly not the standard we aim to provide, especially when you are expecting the refined service that the restaurant is known for. I understand how frustrating it is when a meal you have been looking forward to is overshadowed by a service issue.

I can facilitate a conversation with our restaurant management team to ensure your feedback is addressed and to see how we can make this right for you. If you are looking for a different experience tonight, Ballo Italian Restaurant opens at 5:00 PM and is well-regarded for its attentive service and housemade pastas. Hours and availability can vary, so I can connect you with our host team to coordinate a visit there or to speak with someone about your experience last night. 

Would you like me to get you in touch with a manager now?
